text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff... Whew...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! That was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Watching Hishi Akebono and Taiki
Shuttle race
was like watching a true
clash between titans!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It's fun watching the others run, but
there's just something special about
Bono. That intensity of
hers is second to
none!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Just watching her makes me feel so much
more
energized!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...! Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Taikiii!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yo, Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for today! I'm glad I got to run
with you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Getting to grapple with another big girl
like you
was lots and lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But you know... Losing hurts!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Akebono...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And that's exactly why I want to race
against you
again!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I couldn't have said it better myself!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Today was real excitin' for me too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You can count me in for another round
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The curtain falls on the Yasuda Kinen to

thunderous applause. Then, on the way
home...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, listen to these, Trainer! Fans are
already
talking about the Yasuda Kinen
online!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"I got to see Bono's fiery bout with Taiki
Shuttle
at the Yasuda Kinen in person!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It was an all-out slugfest of a race, and
my heart
is still pounding!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haha!
I really do look big in this picture,
don't I?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And everybody is smiling and cheering
me on too.
Oh, I'm just so happy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I hope they'll be just as excited during
the next
race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's our next race again?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Haha! That's right! We haven't decided
yet, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... It'd be nice to do something
Taiki'll
run in too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I did! I had lots and lots of fun!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Running with Biko is fun too, but going
against
Taiki was a different kind of fun.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It made me feel blazing hot and freezing
cold at the same time and just buzzing
with energy! It was
like "Raaah!" and
"Whoaaa!" you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't say I understand what she means,
but it
seems like her race against Taiki
Shuttle was
really special to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As a G1 sprint, there's a good chance
Taiki
Shuttle will run in it too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
She was in it last year too,
right?! Yeah, I

definitely wanna run in it!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Taiki said she'll be coming back
stronger, so I've
gotta to train harder
too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, we settle on aiming for the
Sprinters S.
It's time to push toward an
even greater victory!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! I can't wait!
I gotta try really hard
to—
